While injecting, a varying mouse is read 370-480 times a second instead of 1,000
Report descriptor over 512 B not served: the interface gets no HID driver
Wooting 60HE+ shape: the 5th interface delivers no reports
A sleeping PC can't be woken from the device: its remote wakeup stops at the box
